svg.text: gs://rxrx: per dataset, a zip of PNGs, a metadata zip and an embeddings zip
1,949,904 PNGs in 916.0 GB of zips, read from the zips' central directories and metadata.csv.
the dataset's README in recursionpharma/rxrx-datasets is wrong

text.tspan: # CC BY 4.0; read anonymously, over gs:// or https://storage.googleapis.com/rxrx/

svg.text: rxrx19a: 1,527,665 members; central directory 190.5 MB at byte 477,505,676,200 of 477,696,173,627
rxrx19b: 422,362 members; central directory 53.2 MB at byte 438,294,245,720 of 438,347,411,230
local header: 30 bytes + name + 28-byte extra field, then the PNG # checked on every member
well names: letters B–AE (30), numbers 02–47 (46) # the inner 30 × 46 wells of a 32 × 48 plate

text.tspan: # rxrx-datasets/rxrx19a/README.md reads AA02 as "column AA, row 2"; but the letters (30) fit the plate's 32 rows and the numbers (46) its 48 columns

svg.text: channel w3 of w1–w5 (rxrx19a), w1–w6 (rxrx19b) # rxrx19a: w3 is Phalloidin, per its rxrx-datasets README; rxrx19b's README names no stains
local header at 132,963,618,065; PNG at 132,963,618,166, 455,182 bytes, stored
columns: site_id, well_id, cell_type, experiment, plate, well, site, disease_condition, treatment, treatment_conc, SMILES
rxrx19a: 305,520 rows, one per site; 305,520 match a site with PNGs, 0 do not
rxrx19b: 70,384 rows, one per site; 70,384 match a site with PNGs, 0 do not
rxrx19a: conditions Active SARS-CoV-2 280,376, UV Inactivated SARS-CoV-2 9,120, Mock 9,120, (blank) 6,904
